title: SHACKLE adds a runtime circuit breaker for autonomous agent actions
friendlyTitle: SHACKLE puts a safety gate in front of AI agent actions
summary: The new pyshackle package mediates agent calls with deterministic allow, deny or human-review decisions and can stop repeated calls, budget overruns and timeouts before the next action. Its SP/1.0 proposal includes public conformance fixtures and integrations for LiteLLM and AutoGen.
friendlySummary: SHACKLE is a new Python package that can allow, block or pause an agent’s next action for human approval. It can also stop loops, timeouts and budget overruns.
whyItMatters: Model-level safety instructions are not a substitute for enforceable runtime limits. Teams operating agents can use a separate gate to cap spending, halt loops and require approval for sensitive tools, while evaluating the young project carefully before production use.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A hard software limit can be more reliable than asking an AI model to control itself. Test the new project carefully before trusting it in important systems.
